programs.title: National Treasure Under Fire Ep.5
programs.desc: Ancient texts were saved through relocation efforts during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression. Behind each rescue was a determination to preserve China's cultural heritage. These precious texts now carry the stories our forefathers, how they fought to safeguard history and the civilization these works represent.

programs.title: From Nubia to La Plata
programs.desc: In the early 1960s, Argentine Egyptologist Abraham Rosenvasser led an expedition to Sudan to excavate the Temple of Aksha. As the Nile rose, he rescued some of the temple's treasures and brought them to the La Plata Museum, where they are displayed today.

programs.title: Cities of the Future Ep.1
programs.desc: This documentary turns its lens to the essential infrastructure of China's cities, filming 35 hidden projects - including flood control and drainage, emergency response, and water, electricity, and gas supply. From the perspectives of urban renewal, industrial innovation, and dynamic development, it offers a true record of China's urban growth that values what lies both above and below ground.

programs.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programs.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

programs.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 2
programs.desc: In this episode, we explore the grand old mansions of Nanjing's merchant families and take a stroll through their exquisite gardens, where Nature is incorporated into the architecture. From centuries-old Qing Dynasty residences to traditional folk handicrafts, join us on a deep dive into Nanjing's rich cultural heritage.
